description: Search a directory of real small local businesses in Europe whose details were confirmed by their owners. Use the customer's own words as the query, e.g. 'property management in Alicante' or 'online QA course'. Returns up to five close matches with name, short description, city, an online flag, service languages, a relevance score and the page URL. The directory is small: an empty result means it has no such business, and that is the answer to give. Always check `city` and `online` before calling a match local: a business in another city is not a local match.

city.description: City the customer named (e.g. 'Alicante'). Keeps only businesses located there. Omit it when the customer wants an online service.

name: search_businesses
title: Search businesses
